text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time and fewer notes typed in parking lots.

**2. CRM quality improved.** Fields were filled in consistently, so forecasts finally reflected what customers actually said.

**3. Customers noticed.** A few asked for consent details up front. Telling them early built trust instead of friction.

**4. Adoption wasn't automatic.** Reps who saw managers use the summaries in coaching stuck with it. Others quietly dropped off.

**5. Accuracy needs review.** Jargon and product names still tripped it up.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed us to use it.

What did your team learn?
